description: Barred brown with an olive tip, and too big for any bird anyone has flushed out of these woods yet.
lore: There are no hawks. A stall cannot sell large brown feather, source unknown, so a man in the second row called it a hawk feather about forty years ago and it has been a hawk feather ever since — every stall, every sack, seven gold. He sells a [[items/barred_hawk_quill|Hawk Quill]] as well, off nothing anyone has seen either. The joke wore out a long time ago. He believes in the hawk now, entirely and with heat, and will describe it to you at length, and the description is the same every time.
gm_notes: A naming that took. Never confirm or deny the hawk: the only evidence offered is that his account never varies, and that is exactly the evidence this world makes hard to dismiss.
